build_wav2vec_u_model: build a wav2vec_u model using Wav2vec_U.build_model with a config and task dictionary
run_discriminator_forward: run the discriminator forward pass on dense embeddings to get real or fake scores
run_generator_forward: run the generator forward pass to project dense features into output dimension space
review_segmenter_subsample: review the UniformRandomSegmenter pre_segment method to subsample features by a configurable rate
review_gradient_penalty: review the calc_gradient_penalty method to compute WGAN-GP gradient penalty between real and fake data
